correctness.rationale: The proof starts from the exact published PSL_2(q) criterion. Even extension degrees are eliminated by explicit factorizations and divisibility, with q=4,16 and q=9 checked directly. Odd composite degrees are excluded by a proper composite cyclotomic factor together with a primitive divisor from Bang--Zsigmondy. For odd prime degree, primitive divisors force both base half-factors to be prime, hence p=5 unless p=3, and the remaining source criterion simplifies exactly to the displayed p=3 and p=5 conditions. All exceptional cases and quantifier boundaries are handled.

value.rationale: The inspected literature identifies the PSL_2(q) arithmetic condition as one of the remaining obstacles to classifying non-solvable power-cograph groups. The finding removes all composite extension degrees except q=16 and collapses odd characteristic to p=3 or 5, replacing a search over arbitrary prime powers by explicit prime-degree cyclotomic conditions. This is a structural reduction of a named obstruction rather than a routine finite check.
